answer_1.quote: We verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework on a dialogue relation extraction task and a response generation task ... We evaluate our model on the DailyDialog benchmark, which contains 13,119 daily multi-turn conversations.

answer_2.quote: We set the decoding beam size as 5 and adopt BLEU-1/2/3/4 and Distinct-1/2 as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation. Following, we ask annotators who study linguistics to evaluate model outputs from four aspects, which are fluency, coherence, informativeness and overall performance.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each generated response on fluency, coherence, informativeness and overall performance using a 0‑1‑2 scale.
